Fixes the theme silently not applying on Windows, and corrects the settings path the docs told you to use.

## ⚡ Improved

- **`install.bat` is simple again.** v1.0.2 worked around the 5.1 gap by preferring `pwsh`; most Windows machines have no PowerShell 7, so the workaround rarely triggered. Now that 5.1 is fully supported, the launcher just calls `powershell`.
- **Installers refuse to run while JDownloader is open.** JD rewrites its own `cfg/*.json` on shutdown, so a theme installed underneath a running JD was wiped the moment you closed it. Both installers now detect that and stop, with a "continue anyway" prompt if you insist.
- **Settings are written atomically** (temp file plus rename) on all platforms, so an interrupted write can never leave JDownloader with an empty config.
- **Linux/macOS: a broken `python3` no longer aborts the install half-done.** The theme file is copied, and you get the manual instruction instead of a stack trace.
- **CI now runs the installer on Windows PowerShell 5.1**, on PowerShell 7, and on pwsh/Linux, against a shared behavioural test suite (`test/test-install.ps1`) that covers the settings write, a fresh install, a corrupt config, encoding and the temp-file cleanup. The gap that caused this bug could not have been caught before, because 5.1 was never exercised.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The theme was never applied on Windows.** `install.ps1` only wrote `lookandfeeltheme` (and the ad-blocking keys) when it ran on PowerShell 7 or newer, because it used `ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable`, which does not exist in 5.1. Double-clicking `install.bat` on a stock Windows box runs 5.1, so the installer copied the theme file, reported success, and changed nothing else - JDownloader stayed on its default light look. The settings write no longer depends on the PowerShell version. (#11)
- **The docs pointed at a menu that does not exist.** README and both installers told you to pick `Settings > GUI > Look & Feel > FLATLAF_DARK`. JDownloader 2 has no Look & Feel entry in its normal settings panels; the switch lives in **Settings > Advanced Settings** under `lookandfeeltheme`. Every place that named the old path now names the real one, and the README explains what to do if `FLATLAF_*` values are missing entirely (an outdated JD core). (#11)
- **Auto-detection missed `%LOCALAPPDATA%\JDownloader 2`.** The candidate list had `JDownloader` and `JDownloader 2.0` but not the plain `2` variant that JDownloader's own installer creates, so users were dropped into the "enter your folder" prompt for a completely standard install. Added for Program Files, Program Files (x86), LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA and USERPROFILE.
- **Non-ASCII settings values were mangled on Windows PowerShell 5.1.** JDownloader writes its config as BOM-less UTF-8, which 5.1 decodes with the system ANSI codepage by default; a path containing an umlaut came back doubled and was saved that way. The config is now read and written as explicit BOM-free UTF-8 (JD's JSON parser rejects a BOM).
